title: Newark substantially rehabilitated vacant unit 10% rent increase limit
requirement: A landlord that rehabilitates a vacant apartment unit by spending at least 12 months of the unit's actual monthly rent may raise the rent by no more than 10%. The increase must be applied for with a supporting affidavit before the Board.
coverage_conditions: Any landlord that rehabilitates a vacant apartment unit by spending a total amount equal to at least 12 months of actual monthly rent per unit.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies where a landlord rehabilitates a vacant apartment unit spending at least 12 months of actual monthly rent per unit.

penalty: Violation of the chapter is punishable by a fine of not less than $100 and not more than $2,000, or imprisonment up to 90 days, or both; the Municipal Court may impose up to $2,000 per violation.
quoted_span: Any landlord that rehabilitates a vacant apartment unit by spending a total amount equal to at least 12 months of actual monthly rent per unit will be entitled to a maximum of 10% increase in the actual monthly rent.

title: Newark 25% annual rent increase limit
requirement: The Rent Control Board may not grant a rent increase exceeding 25% in any one year for any tenant. Increases under the rent increase, major improvement and landlord hardship sections within the prior 12 months are added together to test the 25% limit.
coverage_conditions: Any tenant; applies to increases granted by the Rent Control Board under the rent control ordinance.

applicability.per_tenancy: Applies to any tenant; covers rent increases granted by the Rent Control Board.

penalty: Violation of the chapter is punishable by a fine of not less than $100 and not more than $2,000, or imprisonment up to 90 days, or both; the Municipal Court may impose up to $2,000 per violation.
quoted_span: Since an immediate rent increase of more than 25% above the prior monthly rent may be considered unconscionable and imposes a hardship on a tenant, the Rent Control Board shall not grant increases exceeding 25% in any one year for any tenant.
